title: 第17章 单纯是懂感恩第18章 脱胎换骨求追读
content_zh:
见李青山反应这么大，王孝脸上露出不悦。
他恨铁不成钢：“不就是被睡嘛？别人逛窑子，还要给钱，你现在有女人睡，还能赚钱，多好的一件美事。”
自己当年要是有这条件，睡觉都要笑醒。
李青山一脸正色：“男子汉大丈夫，岂能靠出卖身体赚钱，教习，你太小看我李青山了！”
他两世为人，最难的时候，都没下过海。
岂能受此侮辱！
王孝哼哼两声：“只配七天，之后给你一头至少六百斤的暴食之豚，还教你凝劲桩功、指点你肉身锤炼窍门，保管你肉身境突破的舒舒服服。”
他是真心实意做交易的。
要不是他时间不多了，根本不可能给出这么丰厚的资源！
“七天？”
李青山怒了。
就是真种猪也吃不消啊。
他脸色一冷：“教习的指点之恩，青山日后再报，至于配种一事...”
“你日了，就是报恩！”
王孝懒得继续墨迹。
他一把抓住李青山，连着之前打包的礼盒，快步走出住处。
见李青山还在挣扎。
他好歹也是县城里有些脸面的人，只好哄道：“莫扭扭捏捏，作小妇人姿态，这样，我再耗费贡献，给你兑换一本武骨方面的书，让你能压制住自愈武骨的副作用，如何？”
李青山不动了。
倒不是对方给的价格让他满意了。

单纯是懂感恩。
只希望王孝口中的女儿们，不会太丑。
好歹是这个世界的第一次。
他还是想要个美好体验的。
...
数日后。
李青山只戴着黑色头套，呈现大字型，双眼无神地看着天花板。
王孝，真出生也。
还没喘两口气。
麻木之处，快速恢复。
一旁有纤细手掌伸出，捏开李青山的下巴，将滚烫的珍贵秘药，灌入他的嘴中。
随着药效发作。
同样戴着头套，看不清容貌的女子爬了上去。
定格的镜头，再次一上一下地晃动起来...
...
content_en:
Seeing Li Qingshan's reaction, Wang Xiao's face showed displeasure.
He hated that iron could not become steel: "Isn't it just to be slept with? Others have to pay for visiting the brothels. Now you have a woman to sleep with and you can still make money. What a wonderful thing."
If I had this condition back then, I would wake up laughing even when I go to bed.
Li Qingshan looked serious: "How can a man make money by selling his body? Teach me, you underestimate me, Li Qingshan!"
In his two lifetimes, during the most difficult times, he never went to the sea.
How can you be insulted like this!
Wang Xiao snorted twice: "You are only allowed to live for seven days. After that, I will give you a gluttonous dolphin of at least 600 kilograms. I will also teach you the Condensation Pole Kung Fu, give you tips on physical training, and keep you comfortable as you break through the physical realm."
He truly meant the deal.
If he hadn't run out of time, it would have been impossible to provide such generous resources!
"Seven days?"
Li Qingshan was angry.
Even real pigs can’t bear it.
His face turned cold: "Qingshan will repay the kindness of the teacher in the future. As for the breeding..."
"You are here to repay the favor!"
Wang Xiao was too lazy to continue inking.
He grabbed Li Qingshan and quickly walked out of the residence with the gift box he had packed before.
Seeing that Li Qingshan was still struggling.
After all, he was a respectable person in the county, so he had no choice but to coax: "Don't be coy and act like a little lady. How about I spend my contribution to redeem a book on martial arts for you so that you can suppress the side effects of self-healing martial arts?"
Li Qingshan stopped moving.
It's not that the price given by the other party satisfied him.
Simply know how to be grateful.
I just hope that the daughters Wang Xiao talks about will not be too ugly.
At least it is the first time in this world.
He still wants a good experience.
...
A few days later.
Li Qingshan only wore a black hood with large fonts and his eyes were looking at the ceiling blankly.
Wang Xiao is really born.
Haven't even taken a breath yet.
Where there is numbness, recovery is quick.
A slender hand stretched out from the side, pinched open Li Qingshan's chin, and poured the hot precious secret medicine into his mouth.
As the drug takes effect.
The woman, who was also wearing a hood and couldn't see her face clearly, climbed up.
The frozen lens started to move up and down again...
...
